 Karrueche Tran has the internet talking after sharing her thoughts on having children. She recently opened up about the possibility of becoming a mom, and chileee, it didn’t take long for fans to start bringing Deion Sanders into the conversation. Now, folks are sounding OFF online with their own thoughts.
 RELATED: Karrueche Tran Reveals Deion Sanders’ ONE Wild Rule After Asking Him To Pay For Her Boob Job (VIDEO)  
 Karrueche Tran Gets Real About Having Children
 Recently, Karrueche Tran kept it a stack about her thoughts on motherhood and having children during an episode of her ‘Pop Exchange’ podcast. The actress admitted that she’s getting tired of folks constantly telling her it’s time for her to have kids. Karrueche explained that while she does want to become a mom one day, she’s still figuring things out and seeking clarity on whether she’ll be able to have children. Additionally, she described the frequent questions and pressure as “rude and inconsiderate.”  But even with that, Karrueche made it clear that she “loves kids” and still hopes to experience motherhood one day.
 Fans Weigh In With Thoughts On Karrueche’s Baby Talk
 Once folks online peeped Karrueche’s comments about having kids, fans wasted no time bringing Deion Sanders into the mix . Some felt Coach Prime was already past the stage of having more children, while others encouraged Karrueche to move at her own pace and pay the haters NO mind!

 Instagram user @ ashle_ebanks wrote, “ I love her💕💕 she’s so authentic & always been 👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾”  
 Instagram user @ jazzmynerain wrote, “ I hate that people are so comfortable with crossing the line of telling someone they need kids.”  
 While Instagram user @ williemorgan4840 wrote, “ Deion probably doesn’t want any more kids. I wish them well.”  
 Then Instagram user @ essence.3212 wrote, “ You and Deion are both adults.He is a GREAT father and you would make a great mother if you choose to have a baby.That man is fineeee don’t listen to the miserable haters.Lots of famous couples have kids later in life your much more equip.”  
 Another Instagram user @ killahmel_ wrote, “ She’s probably waiting for marriage, I feel it.”  
 Instagram user @ rhobidebbs wrote, “ Prime ain’t having no more kids.”  
 While another Instagram user, @ prettybrownandpoppin, wrote, “ Stay out of women’s uterus!”  
 Then another Instagram user @ pperez4eva wrote, “ U already a step mom! You good! 😍”  
 Lastly, Instagram user @yoo_shes_fiyah wrote, “ People really need to mind their own business.”  
 Karrueche Reveals What She Adores About Deion
 Even without the baby talk, fans have been locked in on Karrueche Tran and Deion Sanders’ relationship. Karrueche has been giving folks lil’ glimpses into their love life on her podcast. Recently, she spilled the tea on her favorite part of their relationship, revealing that she loves how they can always laugh and joke together. She also gave Deion props for his resilience, sharing how much she admires his ability to push through life challenges without letting them bring him down.  “But I love that he never allowed this situation to hinder anything in his life,”  Karrueche said.
